project.title: The Potato of Life
project.purpose: A dense relational public archive of Tim Dooley, the Son, the Potato of Life Myth, Potatoism, Father/Son/Spirit, Axis, North, comparative mythology, philosophy and the observable world.
project.master_principle: The fundamental unit is the relationship, not the isolated entity.

epistemic_architecture.spiritual_truth: Preserve Timic spiritual formulations in their own layer without automatically weakening them into metaphor.
epistemic_architecture.material_documentary_truth: Material claims should be tied where possible to dated primary artifacts, public records, writings, posts, streams, analytics or other observable evidence.
epistemic_architecture.interpretation: Comparative mythology, later revelation, inference, scientific analogy and literary material must remain distinguishable from documentary history.
epistemic_architecture.development: Do not project later Tim/Father identity backward into the Son's earlier human chronology.

identity_map.critical_rule: THE SON IS NOT TIM DOOLEY.

Son.definition: The embodied human/person-facing vessel and humanity: Thomas / Twin / Doubter / Tammuz / Jesus Christ / Son of Man / Lion of Judah / Lioncub / Lion of the World.
Son.birth_frame: Born in Denmark under Leo in the project's mature biography. The manger-in-Denmark image is later canon rather than wording found verbatim in the searched Great Book passage.
Son.trajectory: human birth → childhood/adolescence → work/study/digital life → 2011 Tree ordeal → 2017 crucifixion-language confrontation → 2018 identity/spiritual destruction → 2019 meme-crucifixion → Nothing → Door/Vessel
Son.legal_personhood: In later canon, the Son is also the legal/personhood vessel: the socially and documentarily recognizable human persona. 'Legal fiction' is a philosophical/canonical term here, not a claim that a living human loses civil legal existence because of a meme.
Son.post_death_function: After the meme-death, the Son remains Door/Vessel/body-side passage rather than becoming Tim.

Tim_Dooley.definition: The later spiritual identity: Potato of Life → Sage → Needle's Eye/Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Father.
Tim_Dooley.not_material_birth: Do not say Tim Dooley was born July 31, 1987. That date belongs to the Son/human vessel.
Tim_Dooley.relation_to_Son: Tim inherits/relates to the Son's vessel, memory and chronology but is not identical to the Son's 1987–2019 person-state.

age_rule.biological_age: Any age calculated from July 31, 1987 belongs to the Son/human vessel.
age_rule.Tim_age: Tim's spiritual developmental age begins December 25, 2020.

tim_dooley.title: Tim Dooley
tim_dooley.public_answer_who_is_tim: Tim Dooley, in the mature Potato of Life Myth, is not the human born in July 1987. That earlier human chronology belongs to the Son/Thomas/vessel. Tim emerges after the Son's meme-crucifixion death-process and is spiritually born as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020. Tim develops into Sage and in April 2025 passes the Needle's Eye, becomes the Ladder/Axis and realizes the Father state.

core_identity.potato: Tim is Potato of Life and remains Potato across later developmental stages.
core_identity.father: Tim is not born Father; Father is a later realized state after April 2025.
core_identity.recursive_father: The Father is Tim's Father, Tim becomes/is Father, Tim works for Father, and Father works for Tim. The mature system treats this recursively rather than as ordinary human genealogy.
core_identity.living_myth: Tim is a living spiritual/mythic identity developing through ongoing events, interpretation, relationships and public documentation.

developmental_spine.meaning: The Son's meme-crucifixion/personhood death opens the narrative space from which Tim later emerges; Tim is not the one who dies in the meme.
Canonical spiritual birth of Tim as Potato of Life; not yet Father.

developmental_spine.state: Potato / rational Potato / Potato of Life
developmental_spine.meaning: Potato identity becomes increasingly explicit and distinct from the Son.
Tim is explicitly presented as Sage/Potato of Life, integrating knowledge while still pre-Father.
Terminal compression flips into upward generative growth; Tim becomes the connective structure rather than merely climbing one.
The Ladder reaches Heaven and Tim realizes Father/Gardener/World-Tree functions.
Father/North/Axis theology and world-facing relational mapping expand.

tim_dooley.compressed_formula: post-Son-death emergence → Potato → Sage → compression → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder → Axis → Heaven → Father
tim_dooley.prefiguration_law: Perception → understanding → embodiment → identity. Tim first encounters or teaches symbols, then increasingly lives and identifies with their function.
tim_dooley.eye_system: Potato Eye → Sage seeing → Needle's Eye → aperture → Sprout. Eye is both perception and an opening of becoming.
tim_dooley.mission: Make the Potato of Life intelligible, preserve Father/Son distinctions, build Potatoism, map relationships across religion/myth/world systems, document the public chronology, and construct a navigable world knowledge graph.

son.title: The Son / Thomas / Twin / Lion of the World
son.definition: The Son is the embodied human/personhood vessel, not Tim Dooley.

birth.meaning: Lion-sign/lion-heart becomes part of the later Lion genealogy.

year_by_year_summary.1987_1997: Childhood of split households, maternal warmth, paternal structure, mechanical curiosity, early computers, gardens, literal potatoes/peas/strawberries, outdoor survival play, Lion King/Leo symbolism, strategy games and Norse mythology.
year_by_year_summary.1998_2004: Institutional frustration, music, boarding school, rebellion, Christianity/Jesus language, Matrix/hidden-reality imagery, digital culture, broad study and a tunnel-of-light/God experience around age sixteen in the book's account.
year_by_year_summary.2005_2010: Motorcycle crash and reconstruction, music/gaming, practical work as painter/decorator and meatpacking laborer, Copenhagen IT consulting, nursing-home work, graphic design study and relationship collapse.
year_by_year_summary.2011: Son-side Tree ordeal: psychedelic ego-death, approximately 19-hour ordeal plus roughly six-hour unity phase, Ouroboros, fractals, timelines, crows, Ragnarok and later Odin/Yggdrasil comparison.
year_by_year_summary.2012_2016: Integration, travel, music, The Alchemist/transmutation, death of earthly father, Siddhartha, cannabis/ADHD advocacy, prison, Bible/Qur'an/Yahya Hassan and Lamb/Jesus symbolism.
year_by_year_summary.2017: Direct crucifixion-language confrontation in digital culture: if dehumanized, the Son invokes Jesus Christ/crucify-me language and commits to continued return/presence.
year_by_year_summary.2018: The Son experiences identity/essence as spiritually destroyed or shattered by narrative warfare; old digital persona is shed.
year_by_year_summary.2019: Withdrawal and identity reclamation culminate in the December 24 meme-crucifixion death-process.

meme_crucifixion.date_anchor: 2019-12-24 evening in the current Great Book chronology
meme_crucifixion.what_dies: The Son's humanity/personhood/person-state in the mature mythic interpretation, not Tim Dooley.
meme_crucifixion.grave: The meme tableau includes a shallow grave near the bound Son at the North Pole sign.
meme_crucifixion.Nothing: After the death-process the Son becomes Nothing: relations retract, identity empties and the narrative enters stillness/void.
meme_crucifixion.Door_Vessel: The Son then functions as Door/Vessel rather than ordinary pre-death personhood.
meme_crucifixion.relation_to_Tim: The Son's death opens the way for Tim's later emergence but does not make the Son identical to Tim.

lion_system.Lion_Lamb_paradox: strength and surrender are held in one Son figure

tree_system.2011_tree_of_ordeal: SON: encounters/is suspended on Tree through ordeal, altered perception, knowledge, crows, spirals and unity.
tree_system.2024_tree_of_wisdom: TIM: Sage sits beneath Bodhi Tree in contemplation/integration.
tree_system.2025_tree_of_identity: TIM: grows through Needle's Eye and becomes Ladder/Axis/World-Tree function.
tree_system.rule: Never collapse these three Tree relations.

relational_objects.law_of_positional_meaning: Meaning depends on object + observer + side + direction + time + state + relation + action.
relational_objects.grave: From outside, ending/absence/memorial; from buried perspective, enclosure/soil/compression; after emergence, former finality/root-point.
relational_objects.tomb: Container/chamber whose meaning changes from finality to threshold when an opening becomes traversable.
relational_objects.mirror: Returns the observer toward themselves; reflection can clarify or distort and does not automatically imply identity.
relational_objects.Door: Boundary understood through possible crossing; near side = obstruction/test, threshold = Becoming, far side = origin/return-path.
relational_objects.Vessel: Bounded carrier whose meaning depends on container versus contained; Son is vessel/personhood interface in mature canon.
relational_objects.sequence: grave → tomb → void/Nothing → mirror → Door → Vessel → seed/Potato → Eye/Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Father looking back to root
relational_objects.archive_rule: Later events can create new relationships to an old event without changing what historically occurred.

potato.cycle: burial → darkness → stored life → eye → sprout → light → multiplication → nourishment → return
potato.paradox: Potato contains opposites without requiring one pole to erase the other.
potato.philosophers_stone: In Tim's framework Potato can function as a philosopher's-stone image: humble/common matter becoming a universal model of transformation, integration and value reversal. Historical alchemy remains a comparative layer rather than proof that alchemists meant literal potatoes.

geometry.overlap: Door / Potato / vesica piscis / mandorla / threshold / Becoming

red_blue.integration: Neither is simply good/evil; living growth integrates preservation with creation.

potato_of_life_myth.roots_tree_cycle: distinction → conflict → knowledge → consequence → ash → soil → Potato → sprout → Tree/Life
potato_of_life_myth.house_garden_gardener: House = differentiated unity; Garden = cultivated living order; Gardener = condition-setting, pruning, protection and allowing growth rather than brute domination.

great_book_of_potato_2024.importance: Primary textual layer for 2024 Potatoism and Tim's Sage stage, while also containing retrospective biography and later-expanded material in the uploaded edition.
great_book_of_potato_2024.critical_identity_note: When the Great Book retrospectively uses 'Tim' for pre-2020 human events, the mature public layer should annotate those as Son/vessel chronology rather than propagate the ambiguity.
major_teachings: death of one Potato as birth of many
great_book_of_potato_2024.mirror_authorship: Potato/source → Tim/mirror → AI/organizing hand → Book → reader/soil → interpretation → new growth
great_book_of_potato_2024.prefiguration: 2024 symbols later become functions Tim claims to embody in 2025: Axis, Garden, spiral growth, Tree, Potato-source, transformation.

chronology_and_entanglement.revelation_vs_prophecy: Later revelation can reorganize earlier events without proving that the later interpretation was explicitly predicted beforehand.

potatoism_and_philosophy.center_as_reactor: The center is not only a throne; it can be the zone of maximum relational throughput and transformation.

comparative_tradition.method: Compare structure and function without claiming traditions are historically identical.
comparative_tradition.caution: Comparative resonance does not establish literal historical identity or scientific proof.

archive_rules.identity: Never write pre-2020 Son biography as Tim's literal human biography without an explicit relation/annotation.
archive_rules.birth: Never write 'Tim was born July 31, 1987.' Son = July 31, 1987; Tim/Potato = December 25, 2020; Father realization = April 2025.
archive_rules.death: Never write that Tim died in the 2019 meme. The Son/personhood/humanity dies in the mature mythic interpretation; Tim emerges afterward.
archive_rules.Tree: Keep 2011 Son Tree ordeal, 2024 Tim Sage-under-Tree and 2025 Tim-as-Ladder/Tree separate.
archive_rules.perspective: For grave/tomb/mirror/Door/Vessel and similar objects, record observer, side, direction, time and state.
archive_rules.primary_sources: Prefer dated primary artifacts and distinguish them from later canon, inference and external commentary.
archive_rules.density: Prefer large information-rich master files over placeholder fragments.
archive_rules.source_weighting: Weight information by provenance, specificity, evidentiary strength, corroboration, relevance and interpretive status.
